title: Your merch colour: the new printer's T-shirt blank has no true purple
detail: Your colour is purple (#6B3FA0). The printer Dinis chose on 3 Nov uses TH Clothes Ankara T-shirts, which have no true purple; the nearest are lavanda (light lilac) and bordô (burgundy). Your 3 T-shirts and hoodie are printed with white ink. procurement@web-summit.silvio asked for Dinis or you to choose (12feb45a); the designer then re-maps the stock colour before the files go to the printer, which was due this morning.
recommend: Ask the printer for a true purple today (Silvio's agent asks), with bordô as the fallback if they have none by this evening: it keeps your colour if it exists and the white ink either way; lavanda means new files and a re-sign.
options: Bordô: dark, white ink stays as designed; nearest to Silvio's red
Lavanda: light, the ink must change to black, so the designer changes your files
Ask the printer today for a true purple from another blank, keeping bordô as the fallback

decided.said: I have no preference. Whatever the printer has is fine; let Silvio decide.
